- Updated scripts/job_hunter.py (details not specified).
- No changes to user-facing features or documentation.

Initial release of Job Hunter: an AI-powered LinkedIn job search assistant.

- Enables real-time LinkedIn job scraping, filtering by technologies, location, experience, and more.
- Integrates optional AI scoring and summaries (requires user’s Google Gemini API key).
- Supports saving jobs, reviewing saved jobs, and search history management.
- Responds to search requests in multiple languages.
- Stores all configuration, history, and saved data locally as JSON.
